scope: 66 verified winning remaster journals; retained evidence must match the current recipe exactly. One route per setup, not all player strategies.

definitions.captureConcentration: Largest capture count at one cell divided by all accepted captures, including bonuses.
definitions.maxRepeatedSpot: Largest total number of captures at one cell; longestSameSpotStreak separately counts consecutive captures.
definitions.noChange: Moves without accepted encounter/objective/supply events or actor phase/intention/interference changes. Ordinary target movement alone does not reset the interval.
definitions.signals: Review concentrated captures at >=3 catches and >=50% concentration; review no-change intervals at >=24 moves or >=6000ms. Heuristics only, not difficulty or enjoyment scores.
